title: Introductory lemma to Olympiodorus's citation of Athanasius
english: From the second book of Olympiodorus, the great philosopher and deacon of Alexandria, against Severus. In it, after bringing forward the quotation from Saint Athanasius that speaks of two wills in Christ, Olympiodorus expounds it in this way, saying—
